allOf.description: IPv4 conditional validation: if CONFIG_TYPE_STATIC, require address and gateway; if DHCP, disallow them.

ipv4ConfigType.description: Triggers STATIC IPv4 mode logic if value is CONFIG_TYPE_STATIC.

then.description: In STATIC mode, ipv4Address and ipv4Gateway must be provided.

anyOf.description: Disallow ipv4Address if not in STATIC mode (e.g., DHCP).
Disallow ipv4Gateway if not in STATIC mode (e.g., DHCP).

else.description: In DHCP mode, ipv4Address and ipv4Gateway must not be specified.

allOf.description: IPv6 conditional validation: if CONFIG_TYPE_STATIC, require address and gateway; if DHCP, disallow them.

ipv6ConfigType.description: Triggers STATIC IPv6 mode logic if value is CONFIG_TYPE_STATIC.

then.description: In STATIC mode, ipv6Address and ipv6Gateway must be provided.

anyOf.description: Disallow ipv6Address if not in STATIC mode (e.g., DHCP).
Disallow ipv6Gateway if not in STATIC mode (e.g., DHCP).

else.description: In DHCP mode, ipv6Address and ipv6Gateway must not be specified.
